firmware.title: Nothing OS 4.1(Frogger-B4.1-260402-1229)
firmware.description:
What's New in This Update Camera Enhancements

📹 Enhanced auto exposure stability for recording via the front camera.
🔭 Enhanced rear camera autofocus performance for better captures.
📷 Optimised HDR brightness consistency for rear camera portrait shots.
🏙️ Refined colour rendering for a more natural and vivid experience.

General Improvements and Bug Fixes

🫧 Notifications that are frequently interacted with may be suggested to be set as Essential Notification.
🔋 Refined the spacing of status bar icons for a more consistent and coordinated layout.
📳 Optimised haptic feedback in the Recorder app for a more tactile experience.
📱 Fixed some known issues for a smoother and more stable experience.
⚙️ Enhanced overall system stability.
🛡️ Updated to April 2026 security patch.

Notes:
Your device may use more power and feel warmer during installation. Performance will return to normal after the update is complete.

firmware.title: Nothing OS 4.1(Frogger-B4.1-260630-1839)
firmware.description:
What's New in This Update Essential Voice Enhancements

🔡 Translation/transcription can now be triggered via double-clicking the Essential Key when using the keyboard. Set it up in Settings > Intelligence toolkit > Essential Voice > Customise Essential Key.
⌨️ Quick switch between translation and transcription is now available by long-pressing the icon on the keyboard.
🎙️ Optimised Essential Voice for a smoother performance.

Camera Enhancements

📹 Lock Lens keeps your video framing steady by preventing automatic lens switching during recording. Enable in Camera settings > Lock Lens.
🏙️ Improved skin tone and colour accuracy for outdoor shots.
🎬 Better shooting stability for smoother capture.

General Improvements and Bug Fixes

🎚️ Refined the volume slider to allow seamless and more precise adjustment when dragging.
⚙️ Enhanced overall system stability.
🛡️ Updated to July 2026 security patch.

Notes:
Your device may use more power and feel warmer during installation. Performance will return to normal after the update is complete.
